data.summary: Nidus Prime is a versatile Warframe with strong damage capabilities through fungal growth and swarming maggots. It also provides support by increasing the abilities of allies while sharing damage taken. However, its survivability and crowd control are limited, and it lacks any stealth mechanisms. The complexity of gameplay comes from the need to coordinate these abilities effectively.
